section_title: Pulse: The Real Estate Intelligence Layer
chunk_content: Pulse is Joule Dynamics' conversational intelligence layer, currently live on this real estate page demonstrating live market comp lookups and rate monitoring. The same architecture can be deployed across other real estate operations—such as 24/7 short-term rental guest concierges grounded in house manuals, or multifamily leasing assistants grounded in building policies and lease addendums. Ask Pulse directly to explore custom deployments for your portfolio.
